what_this_is: Job U (docs/DECISIONS.md, D-49, committed before this was run): the early-years test and the range on the actual hosts with made-up outcomes, then weights, inferred regions and leverage. No price is read.

which_weight_is_which.net_weight: signed weights summed by utility-state and calendar year across every host's stack, then magnitudes summed over years: the headline number's loading on that utility's observed outcomes (D-55; D-56, ruling 7)
which_weight_is_which.sum_of_absolute_row_weights: magnitudes taken stack row by stack row and summed: the figure D-53 reported as 'absolute weight'. It counts a utility-year once per host it is matched to, so copies that offset still add

fuel_mix_cells.what_this_is: For each host, the other rows in its cohort's fuel-mix-group-by-year cells. With none, those effects fit the host's rows exactly and its weight is zero; with only a few of its own matches there, it is in effect compared with those few (D-57)
